notes.subject: אמת בצעך
notes.rationale: 'cubit/measuring-line of thy gain': some render 'the measure of thy covetousness', BSB 'the thread of thy life is cut' — Hebrew literally names a measuring unit.

notes.subject: אמת בצעך
notes.rationale: Babylon's end is measured out with a measuring unit, like cloth cut at the mark.

notes.subject: רבים / רבת
notes.rationale: Same root רב repeated: 'many waters, abundant treasures' — rhetorical doubling lost in Tok Pisin.

translation: Yu we yu stap long planti wara, yu gat planti ol stua bilong gutpela samting — taim bilong pinis bilong yu i kamap, mak bilong skelim bilong gain nogut bilong yu.
